verdicts.reason: A: the CTA, badges and body copy are crammed into a tiny cluster at the right. The 'Find It Near You' button is a speck that sits almost on top of the badges, the body copy can't be read at 320x50, and the can is shrunk to an icon, so the headline is the only legible element. B: the badges and CTA are larger and easier to read, and the can keeps its circle, but the circle is cropped at the top and bottom edges. The CTA is jammed against the top edge and the SUMMER ONLY badge, the body copy is still illegibly small, and the right half is overstuffed while the headline side has more room. B is the less broken of the two, but neither is ready to ship.
